cohort: The study included 298 Twitter users who self-reported COVID-19 infection during pregnancy and a birth outcome (preterm or term), along with a 1:1 age-matched control group of 298 users without COVID-19 infection during pregnancy.
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy, particularly during the third trimester, was associated with significantly higher odds of preterm birth compared to pregnancies without COVID-19 infection.
gest_age: Preterm birth was defined as birth at <37 weeks of gestation, and term birth at >=37 weeks of gestation.
